project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: GUID of the project the nodes belong to. One project per call, each committing its own history.

workflow_guid.title: Workflow Guid
workflow_guid.description: GUID of the workflow containing the node.

node_guid.title: Node Guid
node_guid.description: GUID of the node to update.

version.title: Version
version.description: Adapter version to move this node to. Defaults to the release the catalog's checkout holds.
